desc: Read the input values $H, W, X, P, Q$ and the grid $S$.
Initialize Takahashi's strength to $S_{P,Q}$ and place him at $(P, Q)$.
Check all 8 neighbors of the current cell.
Filter neighbors that are within bounds, not yet absorbed, and satisfy the condition $S_{neighbor} \times X < S_{current}$.
If no valid neighbors exist, terminate the loop.
Otherwise, select the neighbor with the minimum strength.
Update $S_{current}$ by adding the selected neighbor's strength.
Mark the selected neighbor's cell as absorbed (Takahashi moves there).
